text:
Jordan: quick heads-up — canary run for raven-lite-int8 shows a cluster of toolcall JSON parse failures when we run with tight TTL + quick retry budget. logs below.
Sam: can you paste a minimal broken example?
Jordan: example payload we got back: `{"tool":"search","args":[{"q":"safety policies"}`  — truncated, missing closing braces.
Nina: sounds like partial-stream termination. when agent TTL fires mid-token the client closes and we hand an incomplete stream to the parser. quant noise + small KV cache increases chance of mid-token cuts.
Lee: which TTL are we talking about? route-level or client-side?
Jordan: agent-enforced route TTL set to 150ms for this canary to surface slow tails. backoff retry window is 250ms, so retries can race and produce concatenated fragments.
Sam: by concatenated fragments I mean: first stream ends with `...\"q\":\"safety\"}` and second starts `\"policies\"]}` resulting in invalid JSON when stitched.
CI-Bot: canary/raven-lite-int8 run #42 summary: 37/500 parse_failures, median latency 92ms, p99 312ms, retry_rate 6.2%.
Nina: telemetry matches TTL-triggered retries; model replica switching sometimes yields no separator between fragments especially with quantized token boundaries.
Sam: short-term mitigation: on retry inject a seam marker (e.g. newline + `__SEAM__`) before accepting new stream bytes so the repair heuristics detect a boundary.
Jordan: agree. medium-term: increase canary TTL to 250ms, add seam injection, and strengthen json-repair (strip trailing commas, NDJSON fallback).
Maria: can we reproduce reliably? steps?
Jordan: repro: `./scripts/canary_run.sh --model raven-lite-int8 --seed 42 --requests 1000 --timeout 150` then `grep PARSE_FAIL canary.log`. I'll attach the exact log snippet to the CL.
Sam: postprocess fallback: if parse fails and raw text has multiple top-level `{`, try NDJSON split and take last full object. make this opt-in per-route and emit telemetry when used.
Nina: NDJSON fallback can hide semantic truncation; we must flag fallbacks in metrics for QA review.
Lee: also record model-replica-id in parse-failure telemetry — could be replica-specific glitch.
Jordan: action items: Jordan -> bump canary TTL to 250ms, Sam -> implement seam injection on retry, Maria -> add telemetry flag for NDJSON-fallback uses, Nina -> run eval comparing parse-correctness vs hallucination rate.
CI-Bot: CL 4412 pushed: canary-config TTL=250ms for raven-lite-int8.
Maria: I'll add a dashboard tile for NDJSON-fallback counts and replica-correlated parse failures. ping when CI finishes.
Sam: prototype seam injection: on retry write `\n__SEAM__\n` to stream before piping new bytes; downstream parser treats `__SEAM__` as boundary anchor. pushing draft.
Nina: also let's log replica-id and retry-attempt number for each parse-failure event.
Jordan: final note: during canary keep retry budget conservative so we don't inflate failures.
Lee: thanks all, regroup after CI results. :thumbsup:
